main.description: Look up a pending signup by its link token, so the completion form can reject a dead link before the user fills it in.

token.description: Verification token from the emailed link.

email.description: Email address the signup was started with.

pds.description: PDS the account will be created on, where the browser starts the OAuth request it passes to completeSignup.

errors.name: SignupDisabled
errors.description: Signup is not currently enabled on this service.

errors.name: InvalidCode
errors.description: The verification link is invalid or expired.
